selectionPolicy: Target arm is fixed before MoveNet/FSM results for samples 2-4 are inspected.
Selection is based on camera visibility, not on predicted repetition count.
The non-target arm may move but is excluded from the target-arm FSM.

samples.reason: Anatomical left shoulder, elbow and wrist are visibly exposed in the diagonal view.
Anatomical left arm is closer to the camera and less overlapped by the torso.
Anatomical left arm has the clearest shoulder-elbow-wrist chain in the contact-sheet review.
